pilotVoice.title: Voice slot
pilotVoice.purpose: Edit one row in pilotvoiceresourcetable.vrtbl. A stem fills voiceKey and streamPathId only. The three package ids must be set before save.
pilotVoice.packagesHint: votPackage is CRC32 of the stem plus _vot. bankPackage is CRC32 of the picked file name plus _bank. Use as template records the old voice and does not replace these new hashes. dummyPackage is 0x147BC38E.
pilotVoice.donorRemembered: This voice is the template. Save writes the new vot and nus3bank folders. The new hashes stay as they are.
pilotVoice.keysFromStem: voiceKey and streamPathId are filled from this stem.
pilotVoice.addBody: Pick a .nus3audio whose name contains a voice stem, such as VO_1001_P01_0 or VO_1001_P01_0_01_ST_01. The bank id is computed from the file name.
pilotVoice.bankNotWritten: The bank id is written into the voice table. This save does not write a .nus3bank when the tone template is not proven. An empty cue file is not a bank.
pilotVoice.votDonorMissing: Copy votPackage from a voice that already plays. That .vot pack has to be in dplcache.
pilotVoice.votCueNamesMissing: Could not read cue names for {{name}}, so this save did not write a .vot.
pilotVoice.newBankDisabled: New bank stays off until a proven tone donor exists. An empty cue file is not a bank.
pilotVoice.badAudioName: The file name must contain a voice stem such as VO_1001_P01_0. VO_1001_P01_0_01_ST_01.nus3audio is accepted. Letters, digits, and underscores only.
pilotVoice.pathTableMissing: The path table is not in this workspace.

cameraTable.title: Camera editor
cameraTable.purpose: Game-camera preview of clip packs. sys_53(0x4) uses word25 clip hash, not row id.
cameraTable.search: Search ID, clip hash, or sort key
cameraTable.wazaWarning: All four families compile once at boot into one clip map, so a new clip in any family needs a game restart. sys_53(0x4) on a hash missing from the map crashes.
cameraTable.clipHashHint: Editable. Enter applies the whole clip when it has several shots. Use “this shot only” to split one row out. Do not invent hashes for sys_53.
cameraTable.rowIdHint: Editable. Save reorders the whole table by unsigned row id, same as Param tables.
cameraTable.saveBeforeFamily: Save or discard changes before switching family.
cameraTable.previewHint: Preview clock is 60 ticks/s; durations are game frames. The unit stands at the origin facing +Z (game units, about 20 tall) and its target stands 150 ahead. Look-at = target origin + offset; eye = look-at + distance in the pitch / yaw direction (negative pitch = above, positive yaw = the unit's right). A NaN pitch / yaw / distance start continues from where the camera is. Roll is shown, not applied. Ease 4/5/8 are approximated. nuanmb is ignored (OB ships 0).
cameraTable.viewportEmpty: Select a row on the left. The game camera fills this pane.

list.search: Search row ID, clip hash, or sort. Matches still show the full playback order.

copy.shotHint: Clipboard holds this entry JSON. You can edit clipHash and entryId before import or clone.
copy.clipHint: Copies {{count}} shots in playback order. sys_53 uses the clip hash.

clone.title: Clone scope
clone.shotHint: Appends to this clip with sort+1 and a new row id. You can then change its clip hash.
clone.clipHint: Copies {{count}} shots under a new clip hash. The original clip is unchanged.

remove.title: Remove scope
remove.shotHint: Other shots stay on this clip. Sort keys may skip.
remove.clipHint: Deletes these {{count}} rows. sys_53 on this hash will miss.

cameraTable.resetViewZoom: Reset preview view zoom (does not write clip data)
cameraTable.channelHint: v0 = start, v1 = end. Pitch / yaw / roll / FOV are degrees on disk. Empty v0 on a later shot continues from the current camera; empty v1 makes v2 -> v3 a per-tick rate. Ease: 0/1 constant speed; 2 slow start, still moving at the end; 3 fast start, slow end; 4 slow-fast-slow; 5 holds, then rushes late; 6 rushes early, then nearly still for the last 30%. Values commit on Enter or when the field loses focus.

lookAt.title: Look-at
lookAt.hint: Offset from the origin in the frame, moved from start to end over the shot. Empty start = 0, empty end = start.

preview.notice_handoverStart: Shot 1 has NaN starts: in game it begins from the battle camera; the preview starts from the camera's default hand-over pose.
preview.notice_stageChecks: Clip kind 1 / 2 turns on stage ray checks: in game the clip ends when the eye-to-look-at ray hits the stage. Win/lose clips use 3.
preview.unsupported_positionTarget: Shot {{shot}}: origin {{value}} is not previewed (1, 2, 3 are).
preview.unsupported_orientationTarget: Shot {{shot}}: frame {{value}} is not previewed (1-4 are).
